operations.description: Retrieves the profile information of the currently authenticated user.
Updates the profile information of the currently authenticated user.
Retrieves the profile information of a specific user by their ID.
Uploads a new avatar image for the currently authenticated user. Replaces the existing avatar if one exists.
Retrieve a paginated list of activities with optional search, filter, and sort options.
Creates a new activity with the provided information. Requires Admin or Manager role.
Retrieve detailed information for a specific activity by its ID. Students must pass programEnrollmentId.
Updates the details of a specific activity by its ID. Requires Admin or Manager role.
Soft-deletes an activity by its ID. Requires Admin or Manager role.
Creates activity progress for a module enrollment and sets status to InProgress. Requires Student role.
Marks an activity as Done for the given module enrollment and recalculates module/program progress. Requires Student role.

Test-only endpoint that forces any activity to Done for a given student, bypassing all business rules (enrollment status, ownership, activity type, sequential lock, schedule windows). The module enrollment is resolved automatically. Requires Mentor or Manager role.
Retrieve a paginated list of assignments, each carrying module/program context for the Edit deep-link. Supports search, filter, and sort options.
Creates a new assignment for a module. Requires Admin or Manager role.
Retrieve an assignment by its ID. Students must have an active enrollment in the assignment's module.
Updates an assignment by its ID. Managers/Admins may update all fields. Mentors may update Title, Description, DueDate, AvailableFrom, and AvailableUntil for assignments in programs they teach.
Soft-deletes an assignment by its ID. Requires Admin or Manager role.
Returns submissions of the assignment made by students actively enrolled in the given class. Mentors may only view classes they are assigned to.
Student turns in a FileUpload assignment. Quizzes and retrospectives use their dedicated endpoints. Provide ContentText and/or FileUrl.
Returns a FileUpload submission. Access is enforced per role.
Uploads a deliverable file to S3 only (no DB write) and returns the file URL for use in submit.
Mentor, Manager, or Admin grades a turned-in submission against the assignment's pass score, or returns it for revision. Grading recalculates module and program progress.
Creates a new user account with the provided registration information.
Authenticate user and return JWT tokens.
Logs out the currently authenticated user.
Sends a password reset link to the specified email if it exists.
Reset user password using token sent to email.
Refresh JWT access token using a valid refresh token.
Resend OTP to user's email for registration or password reset.
Verify OTP for email confirmation and activate account.
Students see their own certificates. Parents see linked students. Admins see all program certificates.
Full show-page payload for an issued program certificate.
Returns the program certificate for an enrollment when issued; otherwise null data.
Public endpoint for the FE share/verify page.
Issues a program certificate when all activities are Done. Regenerates and re-uploads the PDF (including avatar/thumbnail images). Reuses the same certificate code when already issued.
Lists Draft/Open classes with no assigned mentor. Prefer GET /api/class-mentor-requests/board.
Retrieve a paginated list of cohort classes with basic information only. Use GET /api/classes/{id} for full details including SeatsTaken.
Creates a new class cohort in Draft status. Requires Admin or Manager role.

Retrieve class details including active enrolled students. Students may view the roster only for a class they are actively enrolled in. Admin and Manager may view any class roster. Mentors may only view classes they own.
Retrieve class details including all scheduled sessions for the cohort, ordered by start time.
Retrieve detailed information for a specific class cohort by its ID, including SeatsTaken.
Updates class cohort details. Status changes must use Open, Start, or Complete endpoints. Requires Admin or Manager role.
Soft-deletes a Draft or Open class cohort and its sessions. Open classes may only be deleted when they have no active students. Requires Manager role.
Transitions a class from Draft to Open. Requires Admin or Manager role.
Transitions a class from Open to InProgress. Requires Admin or Manager role.
Transitions a class from InProgress to Completed. Requires Admin or Manager role.
Joins a class cohort within an active program enrollment. The selected class must belong to the same program. Requires Student role.
Moves the student from the current class to another cohort within the same program. Requires Student role.
Retrieve a class enrollment. Students see their own; parents see linked students; admins see all.

Marks the student's current active class enrollment as Transferred and creates a new Active enrollment in another Open cohort within the same program. Target class must be Open (not yet started). Requires Manager role.
Lists class enrollments for a program enrollment. Access is enforced per role.
Lists Draft/Open classes with no assigned mentor that mentors can request.
Draws questions from the assignment's question bank into a class-scoped editable copy. Re-pull replaces any prior unlocked set.
Edits the class-scoped copy only. Locked after any student submission exists for this assignment in the class.
Retrieve a paginated list of scheduled sessions for a class cohort.
Schedules a new session for a class cohort. Requires Admin or Manager role.
Retrieve class session details including attendance roster. Students receive only their own row; mentors, managers, and super admins receive the full roster.
Retrieve detailed information for a specific class session.
Updates a scheduled class session. Requires Admin or Manager role.
Soft-deletes a class session. Requires Admin or Manager role.
Retrieve a paginated list of courses with optional search, filter, and sort options.
Creates a new course with the provided information. Requires Admin or Manager role.
Retrieve detailed information for a specific course by its ID.
Updates the details of a specific course by its ID. Requires Admin or Manager role.
Soft-deletes a course by its ID. Requires Admin or Manager role.
Retrieve a single course by its exact name (case-insensitive).

Returns trimmed KPI summaries for revenue, enrollment, assessment, and operations (no trends / top-N). Prefer /landing for the home page to avoid duplicate section fetches. Status filters that do not apply to a section are ignored.
Returns full revenue, enrollment, assessment, and operations sections (KPIs + trends + top-N) in one response so the landing page does not call each section endpoint separately.
Honors date range, programId/moduleId/classId, paymentStatus, and pagination for top programs. Other status filters are ignored.
Honors date range, programId/moduleId/classId, enrollmentStatus, classEnrollmentStatus, and pagination for top programs. Other status filters are ignored.
Honors date range, programId/moduleId/classId, and submissionStatus. Other status filters and pagination are ignored.
Honors date range, programId/moduleId/classId, classStatus, and pagination for mentor utilization. Other status filters are ignored.
Retrieve a paginated list of experts with optional search, filter, and sort options.
Creates a new expert with the provided information. Requires Admin or Manager role.
Retrieve detailed information for a specific expert by its ID.
Updates the details of a specific expert by its ID. Requires Admin or Manager role.
Soft-deletes an expert by its ID. Requires Admin or Manager role.
Assigns a program to an expert. Optional request body may include RoleInBoard. Requires Admin or Manager role.
Updates the program assignment for an expert. Requires Admin or Manager role.
Removes a program assignment from an expert. Requires Admin or Manager role.

Creates a highlight stack for a student in a class and starts the first video job. If StudentId is omitted, the authenticated user from the JWT is used. Students may only create for themselves; staff may pass studentId.
Lists highlight stacks for a class and student. If studentId is omitted, the authenticated user from the JWT is used.
Retrieves one highlight stack and its video items by stack ID.
Soft-deletes a highlight stack and all of its video items.
Creates a new Initial item on the stack using the stack strength description. Requires an available slot (max 4) and no concurrent Processing item.
Returns TaggingComplete class videos verified-tagged for the stack student, including face segments when available. Use before POST .../add-segment.
Returns phase (BuildingClips / Encoding / terminal) and optional MediaConvert percent.
Marks a Processing item as Cancelled and best-effort cancels the MediaConvert job. Late completion webhooks are ignored.
Resets the same Initial item to Processing and re-enqueues generation. Trim/SegmentAdd failures should be deleted and re-run instead.
Starts a trim job that excludes the given time ranges from a completed highlight video.
Inserts a source media segment into the highlight manifest by source timeline order and re-encodes.
Soft-deletes one highlight video item so another can be generated in the stack. Cannot delete while Processing; Cancelled and Failed items may be deleted.
Retrieve all invoices issued for the current user (student or parent), sorted by most recent.
Returns the details of an invoice by its Invoice ID.
Returns the invoice created automatically after a successful payment. Returns 404 if the payment has not been confirmed.
Retrieve a paginated list of materials, each carrying program/course/activity context for the Edit deep-link. Supports search, filter, and sort options.

Uploads learning material to S3 for a SelfPaced activity. Supported formats: PDF (≤50 MB), DOC/DOCX (≤50 MB), Video .mp4/.mov/.avi/.mkv (≤3 GB), Image .jpg/.jpeg/.png/.gif/.webp (≤10 MB). ActivityId is required.
Returns the learning material for a SelfPaced activity. Students must pass programEnrollmentId for enrollment-scoped access.
Updates the title of a material.
Soft-deletes the material and removes the corresponding file from S3.

Uploads an image (.jpg, .jpeg, .png) or video (.mp4, .mov) for a class. classId is required; classSessionId is optional and must belong to that class. Images are auto face-tagged immediately. Videos: raw upload + MediaConvert submit in one request; AWS SNS webhooks complete transcode and start Rekognition. Call POST /api/media/{mediaId}/process-tags to poll face tags if webhooks are delayed.

Returns paginated media scoped by role. Manager/Admin/Mentor see all video statuses by default (including Transcoding / PendingTagging). Filter with videoStatus=TaggingComplete for ready-only. Student always sees own tagged ready media; Parent requires linked studentId.

Returns paginated media for a class without face tags. Student must be Active-enrolled in the class. Includes all video statuses (Transcoding, PendingTagging, TaggingComplete, Failed). Supports the same filters/sort/pagination as GET /api/media.

Returns paginated class media from every class the student is Active-enrolled in. Filter with programId and/or classId. Same filters/sort/pagination as class gallery. Use POST /api/portfolios/me/media/from-class-gallery to copy selected items into the portfolio.

Returns one media asset including face tags. Access is role-scoped: Manager/Admin any media; Mentor only mentored classes; Student only ready media they are tagged in; Parent only ready media tagged for linked students.
Soft-deletes a media asset and removes the file from S3 storage.

While VideoStatus is Transcoding, percentComplete is MediaConvert JobPercentComplete (0–100). While PendingTagging, percentComplete is null — poll until TaggingComplete or Failed. Also usable via GET /api/media/{mediaId} for status-only checks.
Retrieves media assets for a specific class session, including face recognition tags. Students and parents only receive ready media they (or linked students) are tagged in.
Manually tags a student onto ready media. Creates a verified tag. Mentors may only tag students enrolled in the media's class.
Sets IsVerified for mentor review of face tags.
Soft-deletes a media tag for the given student.

Submits a new Rekognition face-search job on the transcoded video output, restarts label detection, then polls once for results. Returns 202 while VideoStatus is PendingTagging; call again until TaggingComplete.
Partial update of Title, Organization, Bio, Achievements, and LinkedInUrl. FullName/Phone/Avatar stay on account endpoints.
Mentors manage skills freely (no manager verification). Optional evidence list and IsPublic flag (default true).
Updates proficiency, years, description, notes, and visibility. When Evidences is provided, it replaces all evidence rows.
Students see only public skills. Managers/Admins see all skills for staffing.
Retrieve a paginated list of modules with optional search, filter, and sort options.
Creates a new module with the provided information. Requires Admin or Manager role.
Retrieve detailed information for a specific module by its ID.
Updates the details of a specific module by its ID. Requires Admin or Manager role.
Soft-deletes a module by its ID. Requires Admin or Manager role.
Retrieve a single module by its exact name (case-insensitive).
Creates a new module enrollment attempt after failing the module (two failed assignments). Requires Student role.
Retrieve a module enrollment. Students see their own; parents see linked students; admins see all.
Returns a paginated inbox for the current user. Optionally filter to unread only.
Returns the number of unread notifications for the current user.
Marks a single notification as read. Only the recipient may do this.
Marks all unread notifications for the current user as read.
Student initiates checkout for a paid program. Returns a hosted payment URL (Stripe or MoMo).
Student initiates checkout for a module retake fee. Returns a hosted payment URL.
Student sends a payment request email to a linked, verified parent. The parent receives a 24h payment link.
Student sends a payment request email to a linked, verified parent. The parent receives a 24h payment link for the module retake fee.
Parent uses the token from their email to initiate checkout. No authentication required — the token itself is the credential.
Receives checkout.session.completed events from Stripe. Must be registered in the Stripe dashboard.
Returns payment details. Available to authenticated users.

Called by the front-end when the user is redirected back to the cancelUrl. Marks the Payment as Cancelled and, if applicable, rolls back the parent's PaymentRequest to Pending so they can retry. Idempotent — safe to call multiple times.
Returns the authenticated student's editable draft portfolio with all items and sections.
Updates portfolio profile, theme, avatar, cover image, and links. Subdomain and publication state use dedicated endpoints.
Creates an unpublished portfolio without a subdomain. One portfolio per student.
Live check while the student types a subdomain. Excludes the caller's current subdomain.
Validates and claims a unique subdomain. Send null or blank to remove it while unpublished.
On publish, snapshots the draft for public serving. On unpublish, removes public availability while retaining the last snapshot.
Uploads a portfolio-scoped image (jpg/jpeg/png, max 5 MB) or video (mp4/mov, max 2 GB) to blob storage. Videos are stored as-is (no transcoding).
Returns media assets uploaded to the caller's portfolio.
Soft-deletes a portfolio media asset that is not referenced by any item or section gallery.
Copies ready class-gallery images/videos into independent portfolio media assets. Optionally appends them to an item or section gallery. Does not modify the original class gallery MediaAsset.

Copies a completed highlight reel into an independent portfolio Video asset and appends it to a Gallery section. Idempotent by highlight video item id. Does not create HighlightReel portfolio items or mutate the highlight job.
Creates ExternalCert, Hobby, Extracurricular, or Project items.
Updates manual items fully. Auto-imported items can be hidden, reordered, and narrative-edited.
Soft-deletes manual items only. Auto-imported items must be hidden instead.
Updates display order for the provided item ids.
Creates RichText, Gallery, or Embed blocks. Built-in group sections are seeded automatically.
Updates custom blocks fully. Built-in group sections can be hidden, reordered, and retitled.
Soft-deletes custom blocks only. Built-in group sections must be hidden instead.
Updates display order for the provided section ids.
Idempotently imports certificates, graded capstone projects, and completed highlight reels.
Anonymous endpoint serving the published snapshot (not the live draft).
Retrieve a paginated list of program information without modules. Supports search, filter, and sort options.
Creates a new program with the provided information. Requires Admin or Manager role.
Retrieve a paginated list of programs including their modules. Supports search, filter, and sort options.
Retrieve a compact curriculum outline for a program: modules, courses or milestones, activities, and materials.
Retrieve detailed information for a specific program by its ID.
Updates the details of a specific program by its ID. Requires Admin or Manager role.
Soft-deletes a program by its ID. Requires Admin or Manager role.
Retrieve a single program by its exact name (case-insensitive).
Retrieve a program enrollment. Students see their own; parents see linked students; admins see all.
Students: own enrollments. Parents: linked students. Admins: all enrollments.
Returns the active class cohort linked to this program enrollment. ClassId is null when the student has not joined a class yet. Students see their own; parents see linked students; admins see all.
Returns the latest module enrollment per module for the program enrollment. Use the returned Id as moduleEnrollmentId for module-scoped flows such as research milestone progress.
Returns the curriculum tree with per-student activity and assignment status, module locks, and current activity.

Returns the full program learning tree for a radial mind-map UI (class data excluded). Hub includes program progress. Modules expand to courses/milestones, then activities and assignments — locked nodes are still included so the client can open them. Supports parallel learning via currentPaths and per-node status (completed, current, in_progress, available, submitted, locked). Each node includes navigation target ids for section deep-links.
Persists resume position (video time, PDF page, doc scroll) for an in-progress SelfPaced activity.
Marks a SelfPaced activity as done for the enrollment and returns updated progress.
List program enrollments for a student. Access rules apply per role (self, linked parent, or admin).
Allows an enrolled student to submit a star rating and optional comment for a program they are enrolled in. One review per student per program.
Retrieve a paginated list of reviews for the specified program. Supports sorting by createdAt (default) or starRating.
Allows the review owner to update their star rating or comment. Both fields are optional (partial update).
Soft-deletes a review. The review owner, Admin, or Manager may call this endpoint.
Retrieve a paginated list of question banks, each carrying program/module/course context for the Edit deep-link. Supports search, filter, and sort options.
Creates a new question bank for a course. Requires Admin or Manager role.
Retrieve a question bank by its ID.
Soft-deletes a question bank and its questions. Requires Admin or Manager role.
Soft-deletes a question and its options from a question bank. Requires Admin or Manager role.
Parses a CSV file and imports valid question rows into the specified question bank. Invalid rows are skipped and returned in the error list. Requires Admin or Manager role.
Starts a new Mode A quiz attempt or resumes an existing Pending submission. Requires Student role and an active enrollment in the assignment's module.
Returns quiz questions and saved answers for a Pending submission. Students may only access their own attempt. Mentors may access students in their class. Manager and Admin may access any submission.
Upserts draft answers for a Pending submission. Partial answers are allowed. Requires Student role.

Final submit: merges request answers with saved drafts, validates all questions are answered, auto-grades, and sets submission to Graded. An empty answers array is allowed when all drafts are saved. Requires Student role.
Returns the graded result for a submission. Students may only access their own result. Mentors may access students in their class. Manager and Admin may access any submission.
Creates a research milestone and its linked deliverable assignment. Requires Admin or Manager.
Lists all research milestones for a module, ordered by MilestoneOrder.
Retrieve a research milestone (includes assignment and linked activities).
Updates milestone fields and the linked deliverable assignment. Requires Admin or Manager.
Soft-deletes a milestone (and its linked assignment) when no submissions exist. Requires Admin or Manager.
Links an existing activity to a milestone with required flag and display order. Requires Admin, Manager, or Mentor.
Updates required flag and/or display order for the activity link. Requires Admin, Manager, or Mentor.
Removes (soft-deletes) the activity link from the milestone. Requires Admin, Manager, or Mentor.
Returns per-milestone unlock and submission readiness for a module enrollment. Access is enforced per role.
Returns a research milestone submission. Access is enforced per role.

Uploads a deliverable or evidence file to S3. Lazy-creates a Pending draft when the milestone is unlocked. Returns FileUrl or EvidenceUrls (and SubmissionId) for use in submit. Set isEvidence=true for supporting evidence files.

Student submits research deliverable content for a milestone. Creates the submission when none exists (milestone unlock + required activities + availability). Resubmission after ReturnedForRevision does not require mentor to reopen. Personal AvailableUntil from approved assessment recovery is honored.
Mentor, Manager, or Admin grades a turned-in submission or returns it for revision.
Creates a new Pending submission or resumes an existing draft or revision. Requires Student role and an active enrollment in the assignment's module.
Returns plain-text content and status for a retrospective submission. Students may only access their own submission.
Autosaves plain-text draft content for a Pending or ReturnedForRevision submission.
Final submit: merges optional request text with the saved draft, requires non-empty plain text, and sets submission to TurnedIn for mentor grading.
Seeds all database tables with sample data. Run DELETE /api/seed/clear first when resetting dev data.
Removes all application data from the database (PostgreSQL TRUNCATE CASCADE). EF migration history is preserved.
Returns attendance records for a class session. Students receive only their own record; mentors, managers, and super admins receive the full roster.
Upserts one student's attendance for a class session. Requires Mentor, Manager, or Admin role.
Paged STEAM skill catalog for class requiredSkillIds and mentor skill pickers. Soft-deleted skills are excluded.
